context:
Goal: every device the app ships to is tested before it ships.
Problem (goal): ios-adblock builds for iPhone and iPad, but CI tests only iPhone, so an iPad break would ship unseen; only you know whether iPad is a target.
Based on (read): ios-adblock XcodeGen device family 1,2 (iPhone and iPad), per the ios-adblock CI-hygiene lane, Nov 3.
Based on (read): no iPad test destination runs in ios-adblock CI (same lane).
Departs from: ios-adblock main, which builds for iPad untested — option a drops iPad, option b adds an iPad test.

options.gain: What ships is exactly what CI tests.
options.how: The ios-adblock lane drops device family 2, so the app builds for iPhone only.
options.label: iPhone only
options.lose: The app no longer installs natively on iPad.

options.gain: iPad users get a tested app.
options.how: The lane adds an iPad simulator test destination to CI.
options.label: Ship for iPad too
options.lose: A longer CI run on every change.

ref: ios-adblock CI-hygiene lane session_013NEJL485VByFJqzsMRBr5M; ios-adblock project.yml (XcodeGen device family 1,2)
title: ios-adblock: does the app ship for iPad?
